findings.title: Accuracy and Energy-dashboard meter families split in both English and Swedish name sort
findings.claim: In the name-sorted six-platform roster, the accuracy family (Prediction Accuracy + Diagnose Last Interval) and the energy-meter family (_AccumulatingSensor, DHW members aside) each occupy more than one contiguous run, in English and in Swedish.
findings.mechanism: The Diagnose Last Interval button publishes onto Prediction Accuracy but carries no lead token of it (unlike the #1227 Learning buttons); of the three lifetime cost meters only the total is Cost-led, and Thermal Battery sorts between Space Heating and Total Energy.

perturbation.change: --perturb: in memory, the button's en/sv names take the sensor's lead ('Prediction Accuracy Diagnose Last Interval' / 'Prognosnoggrannhet diagnostisera senaste intervallet')

findings.metric_definition: Production-defined families whose members (less those in a second family) occupy >1 contiguous run of the roster sorted by en/sv name (entity_id: runs beyond one per domain).
findings.phenomenon_property: Every production-defined entity family occupies one contiguous run of the name-sorted roster in each shipped language, once members homed in another family are set aside.

null_control.note: families whose members share a lead read whole

findings.proposed_fix_scope: Names only (new-install entity ids optional, unique ids untouched as in #1227/#1333): lead the diagnose button with the accuracy token; give the lifetime meters one parallel template in en and sv.

findings.title: Swedish name of Sensor-Gap Advisor reads 'sensor gap in the currency' and drops the advisor role
findings.claim: sv.json names sensor_gap_advisor 'Sensorlucka i valutan', which carries none of the English name's role (Advisor/rådgivare) and a currency qualifier the English name no longer has.
findings.mechanism: The English name was renamed (the unit moved to coordinator.currency) while the Swedish string kept the old qualifier form.

perturbation.change: --perturb: in memory, sv sensor.sensor_gap_advisor name -> 'Sensorlucka, rådgivare'

findings.metric_definition: Entities whose English name carries a concept token of the harness's CONCEPTS map while the Swedish name carries none of its Swedish counterparts.
findings.phenomenon_property: Every entity's Swedish name carries the same role and qualifier concepts as its English name.

null_control.note: the mapping does not generate misses

findings.title: Upper Floor Temperature, a byte duplicate of Indoor Temperature, is enabled by default on every install
findings.claim: On all 5 golden topologies across 3 input cycles, the enabled-by-default Upper Floor Temperature publishes exactly the Indoor Temperature (Optimizer) value, including single-zone installs that have no upper floor.
findings.mechanism: UpperFloorTempSensor reads upper_floor_temperature, which the coordinator sets to the indoor reading (its own docstring); it keeps the class default enabled while its disabled-by-default siblings follow configured inputs.
findings.metric_definition: Unordered pairs of enabled-by-default numeric sensors, same unit, equal native_value in every cycle of every topology while the value changes across cycles.
findings.phenomenon_property: No two enabled-by-default entities publish the same value from the same source.

null_control.note: the move is the registry default, not the value

findings.proposed_fix_scope: UpperFloorTempSensor disabled by default on new installs (existing registry entries keep their state, as #1335); README's Upper Floor row notes it.
